what: Mistake: wrote the throughput, async-drain and self-improvement requests as new ideas although BRIEF.md already requires them (line 39 'measurably faster'; A9 'the numbers drive it'; A13 learning curves; addenda 2026-10-12 chunking and parallel work, 2026-10-13 'Athena owns acceleration'); the acceleration mandate had gone two weeks with no mechanism.
why: Nothing traces brief requirements to mechanisms, owners and measures, so an unowned requirement is noticed only when someone remembers it; I did not check the brief before writing the requests.
